title: Deferred-commit fuzzy-consensus for mini-canaries and rollback reconciler
author: Evelyn Park
description: Motivation: Large model swaps can be brittle when early signals are noisy or when small cohorts generate non-deterministic regressions. This PR introduces a deferred-commit 'fuzzy consensus' controller for mini-canaries and a lightweight rollback reconciler that ensures deterministic recovery even when signals cross thresholds transiently. The goal is to reduce false-positive rollbacks while preserving fast safety guarantees for production. Key ideas: 1) Mini-canaries: short-lived, size-bounded cohorts (configurable, default 0.5% traffic or 100 sessions) that exercise new model variants with aggressive sampling. 2) Deferred commit: instead of immediately promoting a canary on a first success window, the controller collects a compact evidence bundle (latency distribution deltas, error-skew, token-level rejection rates, and a lightweight fidelity score) and then waits for a soft-consensus window where multiple independent checks (statistical delta, deterministic contract checks, and session-replay consistency) converge. 3) Fuzzy consensus: tolerate small oscillations in single metrics by using a majority-style rule across metric groups and a decay-weighted history so short blips don't cause immediate rollbacks. 4) Rollback reconciler: background actor that detects incomplete handoffs (partial commit, halfway drained cohorts) and performs idempotent reconciliations with an audit trail and replay token to restore sessions to a safe model. Compatibility: works with existing rollout policies (canary, A/B, mirror) and integrates as a controller hook; no API changes for customers. Config knobs: mini_canary.size, mini_canary.window_secs, consensus.min_votes, consensus.decay_half_life_secs, rollback.grace_window_secs, rollback.max_retries. Testing: unit coverage for consensus logic + golden replay for reconciliation; end-to-end sim harness that runs 10k virtual sessions under controlled drift to validate tail risk. Backstop: when rollback.reconcile_enabled=false we revert to the legacy commit behavior. Implementation notes: controller extended with an in-memory evidence buffer and pluggable evaluators (statistical, contract, replay). Evidence is compact (JSON lines) and persisted to the rollout journal for audit. This PR also adds a small feature flag gate and migration that patches existing canary state to include deferred-commit flags. See docs/runbooks/mini_canary.md for operator guidance and examples.

review_comments: Leo Martinez: Overall this is promising. Two concerns: (1) the fuzzy-consensus default thresholds feel permissive — can we make them conservative behind the feature flag? (2) the evidence buffer persisted format should be versioned for future evaluators.
Evelyn Park (author): Addressed both. Defaults moved behind the feature flag and we added evidence.version in buffer.go; added migration to annotate existing canaries.
Amala Singh: Need stronger guarantees around reconciling half-drained cohorts. What happens if the reconciler crashes mid-repair? Add idempotency tests and a reconciliation tombstone.
Evelyn Park (author): Added reconciliation tombstone and expanded idempotency unit tests (reconciler now records repair checkpoints and replays).
Jonah Fisher: Tests look good; can we add one more e2e with traffic skew + delayed metrics (simulating telemetry lag)?
Evelyn Park (author): Added a telemetry-lag scenario to the sim harness and increased the decay_half_life to be robust in that case.
ci_checks: e2e-rollout-sim: initial run failed (timing flake) -> rerun -> passed
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash on 2026-03-02 by Amala Singh after addressing reviewer feedback and passing CI; post-merge smoke deployed to staging and reconciler ran once to patch legacy objects.
release_notes:
- Introduces deferred-commit fuzzy-consensus controller for mini-canaries.
- Adds rollback reconciler with idempotent repair and audit trail.
- New config knobs: mini_canary.size, consensus.min_votes, rollback.grace_window_secs.
- Backward compatible; feature gated behind 'deferred-mini-canary' flag.
notes: Operational: Operators should enable the feature flag in a non-peak window and monitor rollout.audit_events and rollout.reconciler.repairs metrics.
Follow-up: Add retention policy for evidence bundles (default 7 days) and integrate with long-term audit storage.
Performance: Evidence aggregation adds ~150us median to commit path when enabled; measured in perf-canary harness.
observability_todo: Add dashboard: Rollouts > Mini Canaries > Fuzzy Consensus (vote breakdown, decay-weighted score)
